outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrograph images (time-lapse photoactivation images), not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized intensity over time (each point is an individual measurement from the depicted experiment), with fitted model curves overlaid. The insets show averaged early time-point responses as a time-series with error bars, which is a line-plot type representation exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
